The '''E-11/S blaster rifle''' was a [[BlasTech Industries/Legends|BlasTech]] [[Blaster rifle/Legends|blaster rifle]] which was custom made and had a very limited market. Combining E-11 blaster technology with [[Slugthrower/Legends|Slugthrower]] technology, the E-11/S was primarily used by [[Assassin/Legends|assassins]], [[Terrorist/Legends|terrorists]], and other criminals. It had a selection switch which allowed it to either fire the blaster, the slugthrower, or both at the same time. It could be adjusted to change the simultaneous firing time of both weapons from a tenth of a [[Standard second|second]] to several seconds.<ref name="GG11" /> 

The [[BR-219 heavy blaster pistol/Legends|BR-219 heavy blaster pistol]] was designed using components from the E-11.
